name: Silver border switch — a changeling has the creature types of silver-bordered cards only while it is on
notes: TypeCatalog.officialCreatureTypes (data.js) is CR 205.3m; every other creature type is silver-bordered (TypeCatalog.silverTypes). Battlefield.silverBorder (the "Silver border" button, off by default, saved with the board) adds those to changeling and "all creature types". Here it is on.
